module "D_IdenticalCalls.dss"

product 0 Material "M_IdenticalCalls" backend=Graph
  %0 = TextureParameter(ParameterName="Tex", SortPriority=0) : Texture2D @L5:C1 "Tex"
  %1 = Reflected[TextureCoordinate](CoordinateIndex=0) : float2 @L10:C27 "A"
  %2 = TextureSample(%0, %1, _, _) : [RGBA:float4, R:float, G:float, B:float, A:float] @L10:C16 "A"
  %3 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1), ParameterName="Gain", SortPriority=1) : float @L6:C1 "Gain"
  %4 = Multiply(%2, %3) : float4 @L12:C20 "Left"
  %5 = Swizzle(%4, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L12:C19 "Left"
  %6 = Add(%5, %5) : float3 @L14:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %7 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%6) @L8:C1
  sink %7
